title: Serve concise agent-first MCP instructions
outcome: Every MCP session receives a short routing and recovery contract that teaches agents to use Phoenix's highest-value tools correctly before their first call.
acceptance: A product-boundary test reads the MCP handshake instructions and decisively asserts every routed tool and recovery rule.
McpApplication.ServerInstructions routes by intent and names context_pack, impact, review_pack, and related_tests alongside the core discovery tools.
The capability is represented by its own features[] identifier and BuildInfo.Version is bumped.
The instructions remain concise and accurately describe C# and F# boundaries.
The served text states in one sentence each that domain failures are structured content and that retryRecommended plus retryHint govern transient retries.
